name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for financial advisory firms?
description: AEO focuses on directly answering user questions for AI search, while traditional SEO aims for higher search rankings using keywords.

mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for financial advisory firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional SEO for financial advisory firms aims for higher organic rankings on search engine results pages (SERPs) by optimizing for keywords, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is about being the *answer* itself. AEO focuses on providing concise, authoritative information that directly addresses user questions, allowing search engines and voice assistants to extract and present your content as the immediate solution. This often means optimizing for rich snippets, featured snippets, and voice search, which are increasingly important as search behavior evolves beyond simple keyword queries.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO focuses on directly answering user questions for AI search, while traditional SEO aims for higher search rankings using keywords.
